purpose: Contextual view of a consumer-produced authority judgment
interpretation: Parsing is a declaration, not permission. authorityCardAnswer compares current consumer context and explicit clock before accepting a judgment through a receiver-selected verification port. It never calculates allow/ask/deny from grants.
externalObligations: Verify the actual judge, signature/coverage, every statement/context binding and accepted clock source
Supply current authority identity after withdrawal, even when content snapshot is unchanged
nativeScope: Two receiver fixtures verify signature plus a fixed judgment statement. This is not a live production authority fold.
resourceContract: Caller supplies byte and per-collection item budgets; no ambient clock, I/O, default verifier or universal region list
lifecycle: Contract meaning only. Admission, production consumer verification and public delivery require their separate acta.
